## Triggers
**`AccountTrigger`** runs before insert and before update. It calls `AccountTriggerHandler`.

## Flows
**`Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name`** is a record-triggered, before-save flow on Account. It runs on create and update.
- Version 8 is active and is what runs. The index holds version 9, which is a Draft, so the details I have come from the draft rather than the live version.
- It calls no Apex and has no subflows.

## Validation rules
The index has none on Account. Two searches returned no matches. The index doesn't cover validation rules attached to standard objects like Account, so I can't say that none exist in the org. ## Apex classes
| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `AccountTriggerHandler` | Called by the trigger and delegates to `AccountService`. |
| `AccountService` | Has `preventDuplicateAccounts`. It collects new or changed phone numbers and calls `AccountSelector`. If another Account has the same phone, it adds an error on `Phone`. |
| `AccountSelector` | Has `selectByPhoneNumbers`, which queries Accounts by phone. |
| `RecordSelectorController` | Generic SObject controller. It doesn't reference Account directly. |

The tests are `AccountTrigger_Test`, `AccountTriggerHandler_Test`, `AccountService_Test`, `AccountSelector_Test` and `RecordSelectorControllerTest`.

## LWC
`recordSelector` imports `RecordSelectorController` and references `Account.Selected_Records__c`. It is also used with Case.

## Dependency chain
```
AccountTrigger (before insert/update)
  └─ AccountTriggerHandler
       └─ AccountService
            └─ AccountSelector   (queries Account by Phone)

Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name (before-save flow)   ← standalone, no links to the Apex

recordSelector (LWC) → RecordSelectorController   ← separate from the trigger chain
```

## Things to watch
- The trigger and the flow both run before save on Account. The flow changes the Name and the trigger checks Phone, so they probably don't conflict. Salesforce runs before-save flows before before-triggers, so the trigger sees the flow's changes.
- The duplicate check matches on exact `Phone` strings, so different phone formats won't be caught.
- Version 9 of the flow is an unactivated draft. Activating it would change behaviour.
